views.markdown: Optional Frida Gum provider for HookKit. Requires the matching HookKit framework package.
**Supported variants:** modern rootful (`iphoneos-arm`, iOS 14+), rootless (`iphoneos-arm64`, iOS 15+), RootHide (`iphoneos-arm64e`, iOS 15+)

Patch release. No public API or ABI changes; compatibility version remains `2.5.1`.

## Fixes

- Publish Logos original pointers before activating hooks.
- Preserve legacy original pointers after partial or uncertain writes.
- Reclaim unused continuation resources without freeing active hooks.
- Improve mutation tracking and serialize native memory writes.
- Prevent rebind cache eviction during chained-fixup parsing.
- Correct continuation backing and replacement-pointer metadata.

## Improvements

- Reduce ownership-key and artifact allocations.
- Remove unused internal code and redundant wrappers.
- Fix macOS test portability and CI toolchain/package staging.

## Packages

Gum is optional and requires the matching framework version.

| Lane | Framework | Optional Gum |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rootful legacy (iOS 9-13) | `hookkit-rootful-legacy.deb` | None |
| Rootful modern (iOS 14+) | `hookkit-rootful-modern.deb` | `hookkit-rootful-modern-gum.deb` |
| Rootless (iOS 15+) | `hookkit-rootless.deb` | `hookkit-rootless-gum.deb` |
| RootHide (iOS 15+) | `hookkit-roothide.deb` | `hookkit-roothide-gum.deb` |

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/jjolano/HookKit/compare/v3.0.2...v3.0.3

Patch release. No ABI or export changes since v3.0.1 — binaries linked against 3.0.x, v1, or v2.x continue to load (compatibility version stays 2.5.1).

## Fixes
- **Undefined behavior in the arm64 relocator.** The branch-target calculation in `hk_arm64.c` left-shifted negative offsets (signed-shift UB, caught by UBSan). Pure arithmetic fix via unsigned masking and multiply-based scaling; no behavior change on working toolchains. Verified on-device (iPhone 7, iOS 15.8.3, rootless): full device smoke passes, 0 failures.

## CI
- New ASan+UBSan lane over the host suite (Theos-independent via `HOOKKIT_SANITIZE`), shellcheck + real-Mach-O resolver conformance up front, device smokes compile-checked on all four lanes via `make device-compile-check`, live relocating-inline test split into its own arm64-only binary (arm64e macOS cannot execute a vm_protect R-X page), Shadow 3.7.6 gate now asserts retained facade markers rather than commit ancestry.

Patch release. No ABI or export changes since v3.0.0 — binaries linked against 3.0.0, v1, or v2.x continue to load (compatibility version stays 2.5.1).

## Fixes
- **Provider discovery is now jailbreak-agnostic.** Frida Gum, ElleKit/libhooker, and Substitute/CydiaSubstrate dylib paths are resolved through the jailbreak-root seam (`jbroot()` / libroot) instead of a hardcoded `/var/jb` + `/` candidate pair. This restores those provider engines on RootHide, whose randomized jbroot never matched the old literals.

## Packaging
- Unified package display names across lanes; the legacy package keeps a `(Legacy)` suffix to stay distinguishable in repo browsers.

Per-lane packages (framework + optional Frida Gum provider):

## HookKit 3.0.0

HookKit 3.0 adds a new C API for building and installing hooks. Existing HookKit v1 and v2 projects remain supported.

### New Hooking API

- Create a runtime, add hooks to a plan, then analyze, prepare, and commit the plan.
- Get a separate result for each hook target, including whether it changed and whether an original function is available.
- Supports Objective-C methods, import rebinding, memory patches, native inline hooks, relocating inline hooks, and Swift vtable hooks.
- HookKit finds available backends at runtime. Use automatic routing or select specific backends for an individual runtime.

### Existing Projects

- Existing HookKit v1 and v2 binaries can load and run without recompiling.
- Existing HookKit v1 and v2 source continues to compile, including `HKSubstitutor` and the six original module classes.
- Logos tweaks can use HookKit with two Makefile lines and no source rewrite.
- Projects that call Substrate, Substitute, libhooker, ElleKit, or memory-hook APIs directly can use `HookKitCompat.h`.
- Modulous plug-in bundles are no longer loaded.
- Older provider type and category APIs remain available for source compatibility, but no longer choose the hook engine. HookKit routes hooks at runtime instead.
- See the [migration guide](https://github.com/jjolano/HookKit/blob/v3.0.0/docs/MIGRATION.md) and [compatibility details](https://github.com/jjolano/HookKit/blob/v3.0.0/docs/3.0/LEGACY_ABI.md).

### Packages

- Legacy rootful: iOS 9-13, including armv7, armv7s, arm64, and old-ABI arm64e.
- Modern rootful: iOS 14+.
- Rootless: iOS 15+.
- RootHide: iOS 15+ with no upper iOS-version package limit.
- Frida Gum is a separate optional package for modern rootful, rootless, and RootHide installs.
- The modern rootful Frida Gum package supports iOS 14+; rootless and RootHide Gum packages support iOS 15+.
